messages:
erin.docs: FYI a couple of quickstart snippets drifted and are tripping up users. The CLI docs still show `redwood login --token $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` but the CLI expects `--api-key` now and our sample apps export REDWOOD_API_KEY. New users are getting confused and filing support tickets.

tom.sdk: Oof. We switched flag name in v0.9.0 to be consistent with env var naming but didn't update the cookbook. Which files?

erin.docs: Quickstart README, the CLI cheatsheet, and the Helm chart example in 'sample-apps/k8s'. Also the Helm values have `image: redwood/inference:edge` which no longer exists; should be `redwood/inference:2026-02-15` (pinned).

vijay.infra: The unpinned `edge` tag caused a startup mismatch in staging this morning because the runtime API changed. I recommend we: 1) update CLI docs to use `--api-key`, 2) replace REDWOOD_API_TOKEN occurrences with REDWOOD_API_KEY, and 3) pin images in Helm and add a short note about always pinning in prod.

erin.docs: Agreed. I can open a docs PR to fix the flags and env var names and update the Helm values to the pinned tag. I'll also add a one-line migration note in the CLI cheatsheet: "If you followed older docs using `--token`, switch to `--api-key` or upgrade to CLI >= v0.9.0."

tom.sdk: Also can we add a tiny compatibility layer in the CLI that accepts `--token` as an alias and prints a deprecation warning? That'd reduce immediate breakage.

vijay.infra: Good idea. I'll add the alias in the CLI repo and update chart values in sample-apps. Also adding a CI check to detect `:edge` tags in Helm manifests would help avoid future drift.

erin.docs: Created PR #5033 with the README/cheatsheet/Helm fixes and a short note about image pinning and env var names. Preview: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-5033

ci-bot: docs-preview: build 9123 passed, lint ok.

tom.sdk: I'll follow up with a small CLI PR to accept `--token` and emit a warning.

erin.docs: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: I'll also run a quick grep across the org for `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` to catch any forgotten examples.
